content.short: Bitso Business provides stablecoin cross-border payments and treasury for companies across Latin America.
content.description: Bitso Business is the enterprise arm of Bitso, one of Latin America's largest crypto platforms. It gives companies stablecoin-powered cross-border payments, local payments through Pix, SPEI and ACH, multi-currency accounts, treasury tools and professional trading. Bitso issues its own fiat-backed stablecoins, including the Mexican peso token MXNB and the Brazilian real token BRL1, and settles them on-chain across networks such as Ethereum, Arbitrum and Avalanche. It operates in Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Chile and the US, serving fintechs, remittance firms and exporters, with partners including Ripple and BVNK.
